description: This file defines the core Page class and related components for managing browser pages in Playwright, including navigation, event handling, request interception, screenshotting, and worker management.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Represents a browser page, managing navigation, events, input, screenshots, and workers.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web worker associated with a page, handling evaluation and lifecycle.

classes.name: PageBinding
classes.description: Handles exposing functions to the page context and dispatching calls.

classes.name: InitScript
classes.description: Represents a script to be injected into the page at initialization.

classes.name: FrameThrottler
classes.description: Utility class to throttle frame acknowledgments for tracing.

methods.name: reportAsNew
methods.description: Initializes the page object with a new page report, handling opener and error states.

methods.name: _markInitialized
methods.description: Marks the page as initialized, resolving promises and emitting events.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Resets the page state for reuse, navigating to about:blank and updating settings.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page is closed.

methods.name: _didCrash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page crashes.

methods.name: _onFileChooserOpened
methods.description: Handles the event when a file chooser is opened.

methods.name: opener
methods.description: Returns the page that opened this page, if any.

methods.name: mainFrame
methods.description: Returns the main frame of the page.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns all frames of the page.

methods.name: exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a function to the page context.

methods.name: removeExposedBindings
methods.description: Removes exposed functions from the page.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for the page.

methods.name: extraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Returns the current extra HTTP headers.

methods.name: onBindingCalled
methods.description: Handles a call from a page binding.

methods.name: addConsoleMessage
methods.description: Adds a console message to the page.

methods.name: performActionPreChecks
methods.description: Performs pre-action checks like navigation and locator handling.

methods.name: emulateMedia
methods.description: Emulates media features like color scheme.

methods.name: setEmulatedSizeFromWindowOpen
methods.description: Sets emulated size based on window open.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Checks if request interception is needed.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the page is closed.

methods.name: hasCrashed
methods.description: Checks if the page has crashed.

methods.name: isClosedOrClosingOrCrashed
methods.description: Checks if the page is closed, closing, or crashed.

methods.name: fileChooserIntercepted
methods.description: Checks if file chooser is intercepted.

methods.name: frameNavigatedToNewDocument
methods.description: Handles navigation to a new document in a frame.

methods.name: snapshotForAI
methods.description: Captures a snapshot for AI processing.
